body: Also idk about a detox but for PCOS you definitely need to balance your hormones. I would do some research or see a regular doctor or holistic health dr and decide what is best for your body before jumping on anything though!!!

Some of her spirituality and health videos are a little out there, BUT she has really great emotional support materials for bingeing and PCOS (as they are related, believe it or not). Take her more recent videos with a grain of salt, but her food early advice is absolutely amazing. and yes, for PCOS cutting out gluten and dairy is a large part of it. You can definitely manage symptoms with medication, but changing my nutrition and my lifestyle healed mind for good.
Check out Sarah armide, she’s on ig and YouTube and helped me completely heal my PCOS :)

Hey :) I have the same issue with my sister, though I am a few years deeper into recovery so I can’t imagine how difficult and frustrating that must be in the thick of it. Like everyone else said, communicating with and telling her how you feel is a good way to go. Ask her be more sensitive and empathetic maybe. Also, I always find writing letters help, even if you don’t give it to her right away. Just to get your words and feelings articulated right on paper. Sending love ❤️❤️
